note: 连续 3 个 SkyBlock 日互动会解锁不同梦境台词,第三天暗示藏宝地点。

messages.raw: §fI just had a very very strange dream...
messages.text: I just had a very very strange dream...
messages.zh: 我刚做了一个非常非常奇怪的梦……

messages.raw: §fIn my dream I flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.
messages.text: In my dream I flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.
messages.zh: 在梦里,我飞出了自己的身体,穿过了某种像屏幕一样的屏障。

messages.raw: §fI turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.
messages.text: I turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.
messages.zh: 我转过身,看见自己就站在那道屏幕后面,就站在这里。

messages.raw: §fAround me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.
messages.text: Around me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.
messages.zh: 我周围到处都是奇怪的东西,但最奇怪的是那个巨人。

messages.raw: §fA Giant! Sitting in front of that screen, watching me.
messages.text: A Giant! Sitting in front of that screen, watching me.
messages.zh: 一个巨人! 他就坐在那道屏幕前面,盯着我看。

messages.raw: §fThe giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"
messages.text: The giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"
messages.zh: 那巨人好像说的是外语,他大喊了一声“POGGERS!”

messages.raw: §fThen I woke up in a sweat.
messages.text: Then I woke up in a sweat.
messages.zh: 然后我就一身冷汗地醒了。

messages.raw: §fI'm really upside down, I need time to think.
messages.text: I'm really upside down, I need time to think.
messages.zh: 我整个人都乱了,我需要点时间想想。

messages.raw: §fThanks for listening.
messages.text: Thanks for listening.
messages.zh: 谢谢你听我说这些。

messages.raw: §fI had another nightmare, very similar to the previous one.
messages.text: I had another nightmare, very similar to the previous one.
messages.zh: 我又做了个噩梦,和上次那个很像。

messages.raw: §fI could see myself behind the screen again, it looked like I was talking.
messages.text: I could see myself behind the screen again, it looked like I was talking.
messages.zh: 我又看见自己站在那道屏幕后面,看样子是在说话。

messages.raw: §fI couldn't hear it, but the words appeared on the screen.
messages.text: I couldn't hear it, but the words appeared on the screen.
messages.zh: 我听不见声音,但那些话会显示在屏幕上。

messages.raw: §fThe exact words I told you last time.
messages.text: The exact words I told you last time.
messages.zh: 一字不差,就是我上次讲给你听的那些话。

messages.raw: §fSo weird, so weird.... I need time to think.
messages.text: So weird, so weird.... I need time to think.
messages.zh: 太怪了,太怪了……我需要点时间想想。

messages.raw: §fOnce again, I had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.
messages.text: Once again, I had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.
messages.zh: 我又做了同一个反复出现的噩梦,不过这次有点不一样。

messages.raw: §fI was talking behind the screen again, I mentioned a treasure.
messages.text: I was talking behind the screen again, I mentioned a treasure.
messages.zh: 我又在屏幕后面说话,还提到了一件宝藏。

messages.raw: §fI knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.
messages.text: I knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.
messages.zh: 我知道有件宝藏就在一座巨大的矮人雕像旁边。

messages.raw: §fBuried in loose rocks next to a bridge I said.
messages.text: Buried in loose rocks next to a bridge I said.
messages.zh: 我说它埋在一座桥边的碎石堆里。

messages.raw: §fBut it makes no sense, I've never even heard of such a treasure!!
messages.text: But it makes no sense, I've never even heard of such a treasure!!
messages.zh: 可这说不通啊,我压根就没听说过有这么件宝藏!!

messages.raw: §fDwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...
messages.text: Dwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...
messages.zh: 矮人雕像、桥、碎石堆、宝藏……?真是个奇怪的梦……

messages.raw: §fThe dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.
messages.text: The dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.
messages.zh: 那些梦不做了,这事儿怕是永远都是个谜了。

messages.raw: §fLast night I had another horrible nightmare. I'm afraid to fall asleep again.
messages.text: Last night I had another horrible nightmare. I'm afraid to fall asleep again.
messages.zh: 昨晚我又做了个可怕的噩梦。我都不敢再睡了。

messages.raw: §fThank you. I'll make a strong brew from this that'll keep me awake all night.
messages.text: Thank you. I'll make a strong brew from this that'll keep me awake all night.
messages.zh: 谢谢你。我拿这个煮一壶浓的,今晚就能整宿不睡了。

messages.raw: §fTough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.
messages.text: Tough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.
messages.zh: 话是狠了点,不过也许你说得对。不就是噩梦嘛,对吧?又不是真的。嘿。

messages.raw: §fI wonder if I'll have that nightmare again tonight...
messages.text: I wonder if I'll have that nightmare again tonight...
messages.zh: 不知道今晚会不会又做那个噩梦……

messages.raw: §fWow that dream was weird.
messages.text: Wow that dream was weird.
messages.zh: 哇,那个梦可真怪。

messages.raw: §fI'm still thinking about that dream I had.
messages.text: I'm still thinking about that dream I had.
messages.zh: 我还在想我做的那个梦。

messages.raw: §fWhat's this? A brew?
messages.text: What's this? A brew?
messages.zh: 这是什么?一壶饮子?

messages.raw: §fI need to drink this?
messages.text: I need to drink this?
messages.zh: 我得把这个喝了?

messages.raw: §fOkay well, I trust you.
messages.text: Okay well, I trust you.
messages.zh: 好吧,我信你。

messages.raw: §d§ogulp
messages.text: gulp
messages.zh: 咕咚

messages.raw: §fMeh, I doubt this will do anything...
messages.text: Meh, I doubt this will do anything...
messages.zh: 唉,我看这玩意儿也起不了什么作用……

messages.raw: §fHoly crap this tastes terrible!!!
messages.text: Holy crap this tastes terrible!!!
messages.zh: 我的天,这也太难喝了!!!

messages.raw: §fWhat's the point!!!!
messages.text: What's the point!!!!
messages.zh: 那这有什么意义啊!!!!

messages.raw: §fI guess it was rhetorical, uh?
messages.text: I guess it was rhetorical, uh?
messages.zh: 我猜这是反问句,是吧?

messages.raw: §fWOW!!!!
messages.text: WOW!!!!

messages.raw: §fI REALLY CAN'T SLEEP AT ALL!!!!
messages.text: I REALLY CAN'T SLEEP AT ALL!!!!
messages.zh: 我是真的一点都睡不着了!!!!

messages.raw: §fTHAT'S FANTASTIC!!!!
messages.text: THAT'S FANTASTIC!!!!
messages.zh: 这太棒了!!!!

messages.raw: §fNO MORE NIGHTMARES!!!!
messages.text: NO MORE NIGHTMARES!!!!
messages.zh: 再也不做噩梦了!!!!

messages.raw: §fHERE TAKE THIS!!!!
messages.text: HERE TAKE THIS!!!!
messages.zh: 来,这个给你!!!!

messages.raw: §fThat §edrink §fyou gave me the other day...
messages.text: That drink you gave me the other day...

segments.text: you gave me the other day...

messages.raw: §fIt was amazing! I couldn't have nightmares that night!
messages.text: It was amazing! I couldn't have nightmares that night!
messages.zh: 太神了! 那一晚我一个噩梦都没做!

messages.raw: §fYou should give me another and visit in the morning!
messages.text: You should give me another and visit in the morning!
messages.zh: 你该再给我一杯,然后早上再来看看我!

messages.raw: §fAM I TOO LOUD??!!
messages.text: AM I TOO LOUD??!!
messages.zh: 我说话是不是太大声了??!!

messages.raw: §fI HAD NO IDEA I COULD JUST STAY AWAKE, IT'S GENIUS!!!
messages.text: I HAD NO IDEA I COULD JUST STAY AWAKE, IT'S GENIUS!!!
messages.zh: 我以前完全不知道人可以干脆不睡,这简直是天才!!!

messages.raw: §fWHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!
messages.text: WHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!
messages.zh: 能一直醒着,干嘛还要睡觉!!!!
